correctness.rationale: Identity-started global Lanczos is scalar orthogonal polynomial quadrature for the counting spectral measure. The rational inverse Hermite identity reconstructs the exact residual and all relevant boundaries. Explicit moments yield q1 and q2. The 45-degree block gives the exact binomial sign distribution, while the inverse differentiation and Weyl bound establish unbounded perturbation ratio with SPD conditioning <3. Exact-rational standalone verification (1360 assertions) was replayed, but finite checks were not mistaken for proof.

value.rationale: In the source method, the number of full-size global Lanczos steps is an important computational decision. The theorem proves that uniformly smaller deterministic positive quadrature error does not entail smaller stochastic sign-correction variance; it supplies a minimal spectral model, exact finite-sample law and robust arbitrarily large effect in irreducible bounded-condition-number tridiagonal matrices. This is a substantive boundary for depth/sample allocation rather than a routine computation.
